snippet.title: ICEE Slush Rush Video
snippet.description:
All thrills no spills!
Step up to the counter to serve up the iconic ICEE to thirsty customers. In this multiplayer game of skill, players race against time to fill 50 cups of various sizes and flavors.
Navigate the five flavors with finesse as accuracy counts. Overflow and spills will eat up time while players wait for clean up. Sucessfully serve all 50 customers to win the big bonus!
ICEE Slush Rush combines the global appeal of the ICEE brand with addictive game play, ensuring a hit for your location.
The game’s unique blend of speed and strategy creates memorable experiences that players with come back for again and again.
With vibrant aesthetics and a beloved brand, ICEE Slush Rush will be the COOLest game in the room.
